metadata.question: Does nitrogen dioxide concentration in Wuhan city, China decrease during February 10-25, 2020 compared to January 1-20, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use Sentinel-5P TROPOMI NO2 data (COPERNICUS/S5P/NOFDI/L3_NO2) - Period 1: January 1-20, 2020 - Period 2: February 10-25, 2020 - Location: Wuhan city, China (approximately 30.5928°N, 114.3055°E) 2. Masking strategy: - Use quality flag (qa_value >= 0.75) to filter reliable NO2 measurements - The question is about NO2 concentration, not clouds, so we should mask low-quality data 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Valid Zero: NO2 can legitimately be very low (near 0) - Check collection size first (C1) - Check pixel counts after masking (C2) - Check if results are None/NaN (C3) - Compare mean NO2: if Period2 < Period1, answer A (Yes), else B (No) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const wuhan = ee.Geometry.Point([114.3055, 30.5928]).buffer(20000); // 20km radius around Wuhan const period1Start = '2020-01-01'; const period1End = '2020-01-20'; const period2Start = '2020-02-10'; const period2End = '2020-02-25'; // 2. Data Acquisition const no2Collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/NOFDI/L3_NO2') .select('NO2_column_number_density'); // Filter for period 1 const period1 = no2Collection .filterDate(period1Start, period1End) .filterBounds(wuhan); // Filter for period 2 const period2 = no2Collection .filterDate(period2Start, period2End) .filterBounds(wuhan); const size1 = await period1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = await period2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Period 1 (Jan 1-20) Images: ${size1}`); console.log(`Period 2 (Feb 10-25) Images: ${size2}`); if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log("Insufficient data for one or both periods."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Quality masking and mean calculation function maskQuality(image) { const qa = image.select('qa_value'); const mask = qa.gte(0.75); return image.updateMask(mask); } const period1Masked = period1.map(maskQuality).mean(); const period2Masked = period2.map(maskQuality).mean(); // 4. Calculate statistics const stats1 = await period1Masked.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: wuhan, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2 = await period2Masked.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: wuhan, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const mean1 = stats1.NO2_column_number_density_mean; const count1 = stats1.NO2_column_number_density_count; const mean2 = stats2.NO2_column_number_density_mean; const count2 = stats2.NO2_column_number_density_count; console.log(`Period 1: Mean NO2 = ${mean1}, Valid Pixels = ${count1}`); console.log(`Period 2: Mean NO2 = ${mean2}, Valid Pixels = ${count2}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after quality masking."); console.log("C2"); return; } if (mean1 === null || mean1 === undefined || mean2 === null || mean2 === undefined || isNaN(mean1) || isNaN(mean2)) { console.log("Calculation failed: invalid results."); console.log("C3"); return; } const decrease = mean2 < mean1; const percentChange = ((mean2 - mean1) / mean1 * 100).toFixed(2); console.log(`Percent change: ${percentChange}%`); if (decrease) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
